about: Part of the graph of Storm Charles, Lisbon: Wednesday 11 November 2026: every Source (a URL that was read) and Dataset, with the edges that touch them (cites, produced-by). Same shape as data/graph/storm.json; edges here point to nodes there. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs. Not a warning service: follow IPMA and ANEPC.
origin_note: origin is file#pointer, relative to origin_base; a leading / means relative to the repository root. An edge's id is rel:from>to.
